name: Beru Whitesun Lars
description: Beru Whitesun Lars, born Beru Whitesun, was a human female from the planet Tatooine. She was married to Owen Lars, the stepbrother of Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, the Chosen One, whose son, Luke, they raised after his father turned to the dark side of the force and his mother died in childbirth.
